name: anki
description: Review your AnkiWeb decks above the Claude Code prompt while Claude works. Syncs straight with AnkiWeb through Anki's own Rust core; no Anki desktop or AnkiConnect needed.

ankiwebUsername.title: AnkiWeb email
ankiwebUsername.description: The email you sign in to AnkiWeb with. Used by /anki login.

ankiwebPassword.title: AnkiWeb password
ankiwebPassword.description: Used once by /anki login to get a sync key, then cleared.

syncServer.title: Sync server
syncServer.description: A self-hosted Anki sync server URL. Empty uses AnkiWeb.

deck.title: Deck
deck.description: Deck to review, subdecks included. Empty uses the collection's current deck.

sidecarPath.title: Sidecar path
sidecarPath.description: Path to the anki-claude-mod-sidecar binary. Empty uses bin/ inside the plugin.

showKey.title: Show key
showKey.description: Digit or lowercase letter that shows the answer.

againKey.title: Again key
againKey.description: Key for Again; empty hides the button.

hardKey.title: Hard key
hardKey.description: Key for Hard; empty hides the button.

goodKey.title: Good key
goodKey.description: Key for Good; empty hides the button.

easyKey.title: Easy key
easyKey.description: Key for Easy; empty hides the button.
